anti_dumping.HEDP: YES - DGTR recommended. Case AD(OI)-47/2025, File 6/52/2025-DGTR. Initiated 29/09/2025 (applicants Aquapharm Chemical Ltd & Excel Industries Ltd). Final Findings dated 25/09/2026 recommend ADD of USD 200/MT on HEDP Acid originating in China PR (also China-origin exported from any country; and any-country exports of China-origin) for 5 years, under ITC-HS 29182910, 29221990, 29314990, 29315900, 29319019, 29319090, 29420090, 38099200, 38249900. Dumping margin 30-40%, injury margin 10-20%.
anti_dumping.ATMP: YES - same findings: USD 214/MT on ATMP Acid from China PR.
anti_dumping.PBTC: NO - PBTC/PBTCA is not covered by this case or any found Indian ADD (DTPMP was also dropped at initiation).
anti_dumping.status_of_customs_notification: As of 2026-11-11 NOT yet notified by Ministry of Finance: latest CBIC ADD notifications seen are 24/2026 (jute, 24.09.2026), 25/2026 (rescission), 26/2026 (titanium dioxide, 24.10.2026), 27/2026 (rock breaker, 05.11.2026) - none on HEDP/ATMP. MoF normally has 3 months from FF (i.e. to ~25 Dec 2026) to impose. Duty would apply per MT of goods (60% liquid basis implied by DGTR's per-MT 60%-equivalent analysis; DGTR public-interest table converts USD 200/MT to INR 17/kg on HEDP landed INR 94/kg).
anti_dumping.scope_note: Duty applies to China-ORIGIN goods even if shipped/invoiced by a US trader; salts, formulations and derivatives are excluded.
anti_dumping.interested_parties_note: Chembond is NOT on the DGTR interested-parties list (only Vasu Chemicals LLP as importer/user, domestic industry, Chinese embassy).

recommended_cif_range.HEDP60: ESTIMATE: USD 880-950/t CIF Nhava Sheva (60% liquid, 1,250-1,300 kg IBC or 250-270 kg drums) while no ADD is in force; if MoF notifies the USD 200/t ADD on China-origin HEDP (expected by ~late Dec 2026), China-origin offer must drop to ~USD 720-800/t CIF to stay competitive with domestic Aquapharm/Excel, or quote non-China origin.
recommended_cif_range.PBTCA50: ESTIMATE: USD 1,150-1,300/t CIF Nhava Sheva (no ADD risk). Opening ~USD 1,280, floor ~USD 1,150.
recommended_cif_range.reasoning: (1) HEDP: DGTR shows FY24-25 China landed INR 93,789/t (60% basis) = ~USD 1,098/t landed at 85.43 => ~USD 0.99-1.01/kg CIF (assumes ~10% BCD+SWS in landed; assumption). Domestic producers sold BELOW that landed price (negative undercutting), and IndiaMART domestic HEDP 60% sits at INR 92-110/kg (~USD 1.05-1.25/kg at assumed INR 88/USD, unverified FX). Chinese asking FOB clusters USD 650-1,200/t (median ~1,100, credible bulk offers 650-950); Shandong ex-works was CNY 6,350/t in Mar 2025. 2016 contract-level CIF was 0.74-0.79. For Chembond (~600 t/yr = ~30% of India's 1,967 t HEDP imports in POI), parity vs domestic ~INR 95/kg means CIF <= ~USD 0.98/kg without ADD (0.98*1.10 duty ~ 1.08 = INR 95 at 88) and <= ~USD 0.80/kg with ADD (+0.20). A 5-10% discount to parity gives the ranges above. (2) PBTCA: no recent Indian shipment price visible; 2016 CIF 0.92-1.11/kg; Chinese asks USD 700-2,000/t with credible producers 1,150-1,250 (Changzhou Koye) and LK Nanjing 999-1,999; domestic low end INR 110-125/kg (~USD 1.25-1.42/kg) => import parity CIF <= ~USD 1.15-1.29/kg. Rising 2026 basket unit values (TradeStat 29319090 China Apr-Aug 2026 USD 3.70/kg vs 3.14) and Chembond's comments on input inflation argue against quoting at the bottom. (3) ISP as US middleman adds margin + freight on Chinese FOB; check that Chinese FOB for HEDP60 is <= ~USD 780-850 and PBTCA50 <= ~USD 1,050-1,150 to fit. All recommendation numbers are estimates; ocean freight China->INNSA not verified.
